title: Design: New Customer Bill Invoices To list shows the typed name first
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom.
  • Have at least 5 customers in the organization so the list has rows to order.
  • Start on the Customers page.
  • Open the attached picture bt-p1-03-after-open.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_steps:
1. Click New Customer.
  2. Type a new customer name (for example Lone Star Fleet Services) in Name.
  3. Click the Bill Invoices To field.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The New Customer window opens.

Step 2:

  • The name shows in Name.

Step 3:

  • A list opens under the field, over the fields below it.
  • The first row reads the typed name followed by "(this customer)" (for example "Lone Star Fleet Services (this customer)"), in blue text on a light blue background.
  • The next rows are other customers in A to Z order, black text on white, as in the picture.
  • The Counter Sale customer is not in the list.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12303 (Story 1, Saved default Bill To on the customer page), story SV-12304 (Story 2, Bill Invoices To in New Customer and Edit Customer), story SV-12305 (Story 3, Bill To on the work order and part sale Customer card)

  • S2-R4: “In New Customer, the first option reads "[name typed so far] (this customer)", or "New customer (this customer)" before a name is typed.”
  • S3-R3: “Typing searches every customer in the organization except Counter Sale, A to Z, showing the first 50 matches; the first option is always "[customer] (this customer)".”
  • S1-N5: “Counter Sale never appears in the field's options.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Bill To design" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2prSHgwt2tWCz96QD2DWkd), version 1794239066-4906, read 9 Nov 2026: page "1 Set a customer's default Bill To", pictures "Open" (This build).
